FULL TEXT:
Advertisement for a walk-in interview for
Project Assistant Position At University School
of Biotechnology, GBU, Greater Noida
An Walk-In interview (offline mode) for one Project
Assistant position in the industry funded research project,
under Principal Investigator Dr. Nagendra Singh, Assistant
Professor, University School of Biotechnology will be held
on March 16th, 2026.
The monthly consolidated fellowships of Project Assistant is Rs.
20,000/-. The project tenure is 2 years. Interested candidates
are required to bring self-attested copies of their CV and
certificates for attending the interview.
Essential Qualification: A Graduate/Post graduate Degree in
basic or applied sciences.
Desirable Qualification: Experience in a molecular Biology
laboratory.
Candidates may also send any query/confirmation of their
appearance in interview along with CV in advance
to nagendra@gbu.ac.in.
Venu: University School of Biotechnology, GBU
Time: 10AM
Date: March 16, 2026
